resources.string: Send directly without a prompt. Recognize each batch in order, then combine the descriptions into one answer. Uses the current vision model and may cost more; fine visual details may be lost.
0–100. Batching starts only above %1$d images; at or below it, send together. No vision support: use the normal send path.
1–100. The last batch may be smaller. Batches are sent one at a time; 1 is safest for providers that reject multiple images.
